kjv: which art, and wast, and shalt be
mine: who is and who was, O Holy One
note: The TR's "kai ho esomenos" (and shalt be) is Theodore Beza's conjecture (1582), with no support in any Greek manuscript; all manuscripts read "ho hosios" (the Holy One). The KJV follows Beza and loses the title "Holy One".

kjv: a great voice out of the temple of heaven
mine: a loud voice came out of the temple
note: TR adds "tou ouranou"; absent from A and others.
